14 open-source Broadcom projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered Broadcom Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and SoCs. 7 of 14 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: Nexmon, facetimehd, videocoreiv, InternalBlue, nexmon_csi.
